## Example 1.2(a–c) {#dc1-example-1-2-abc .dc-lesson}

<div class="dc-result"><span data-math="\frac{d}{dx}(ke^{ax})=kae^{ax}\qquad\frac{d}{dx}(e^{ax+b})=ae^{ax+b}"></span></div>
<p>Differentiate the following expressions with respect to <span data-math="x"></span>.</p>
<div class="dc-problem-list"><div><span class="part">a)</span><span data-math="y=e^{4x}"></span></div><div><span class="part">b)</span><span data-math="y=\frac{1}{e^{2x}}"></span></div><div><span class="part">c)</span><span data-math="y=5e^{3x-2}"></span></div></div><p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 2 · Example 1.2(a–c)</p>

::: notes
(a) y'=4e^(4x). (b) Rewrite y=e^(-2x), so y'=-2e^(-2x)=-2/e^(2x). (c) y'=15e^(3x-2). Do not apply the quotient rule unnecessarily to (b); the reciprocal is a useful index-law connection. In (c), the outside coefficient 5 stays and multiplies the derivative 3 of the exponent. Use selected parts as independent practice; no answers appear on this slide.
:::
